bio.text: Grace Meng represents New York's 6th Congressional District in Queens and is serving her seventh term; she sits on the House Appropriations Committee.
Her office says she is the first and only Asian American member of Congress from New York State.
Before Congress she served in the New York State Assembly and earlier worked as a public-interest lawyer.
She was born in Elmhurst, Queens, graduated from Stuyvesant High School, attended the University of Michigan, and earned a law degree from Cardozo School of Law.
